{
  "name": "flow",
  "description": "Phased development workflow: setup → research → plan → gated plan review → implement → review-against-plan → gated report → wind-down. Durable file-based state, resumable from any session. Plus /flow shape: upstream ticket shaping (brainstorm → agreed tracker tickets).",
  "version": "0.8.3",
  "author": {
    "name": "Scott Laing"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/fifersheep/flow",
  "repository": "https://github.com/fifersheep/flow",
  "license": "Apache-2.0",
  "keywords": [
    "workflow",
    "planning",
    "review",
    "gates",
    "state-machine",
    "shaping",
    "tickets"
  ],
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "userConfig": {
    "terminal": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Terminal",
      "description": "What the flow mod's terminal button and /flow-term open in a task's worktree. iterm-split and tmux split the pane Claude Code runs in, side by side.",
      "default": "iterm-split",
      "options": [
        "iterm-split",
        "iterm-tab",
        "iterm-window",
        "terminal",
        "warp",
        "tmux"
      ]
    },
    "splitSide": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Split side",
      "description": "Where an iterm-split or tmux terminal opens beside Claude Code's pane. Right and bottom at 50% need nothing more; any other split uses iTerm's Python API (Settings → General → Magic → Enable Python API), which flow sets up in ~/.cache/flow on first use.",
      "default": "right",
      "options": [
        "right",
        "left",
        "top",
        "bottom"
      ]
    },
    "splitSize": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Split size (%)",
      "description": "The new pane's share of Claude Code's pane, 10 to 90.",
      "default": 50
    },
    "editor": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Editor",
      "description": "What the flow mod's editor button and /flow-code open a task's worktree in.",
      "default": "vscode",
      "options": [
        "vscode",
        "cursor",
        "zed"
      ]
    }
  }
}
